title: Miss Chinatown Philippines
description: Wins Miss Chinatown Philippines 2014, the first major pageant milestone in the public career archive.

title: Binibining Pilipinas & Miss Grand International
description: Competes at Binibining Pilipinas 2016, earns the Miss Grand Philippines title, and represents the Philippines at Miss Grand International 2016, finishing as first runner-up.

title: Returns to the Miss Grand stage as host
description: Hosts the Miss Grand International 2017 coronation ceremony, marking an early transition from competing onstage to guiding the show.

title: Binibining Pilipinas hosting
description: Moves into the hosting team for Binibining Pilipinas, returning to a stage that was part of her own pageant journey.

title: Beyond the Crown
description: Joins CHiNOY TV's Beyond the Crown conversation, reflecting on her journey from Miss Chinatown to Binibining Pilipinas and the ways her career changed.

title: Television, hosting & new formats
description: Continues with Binibining Pilipinas hosting, appears as a judge on It's Showtime's Miss Q&A, and joins entertainment projects including One Good Day and Drag Den with Manila Luzon.

title: Drag Den, acting and pageant milestones
description: Returns for Drag Den Philippines: Retribution, adds acting credits including Replacing Chef Chico, and continues her Binibining Pilipinas hosting work. In 2024, she is named the first ambassador of Mr. and Ms. Chinatown Global.

title: 2 Steps Back with Nicole and Cat
description: Launches a podcast project with Catriona Gray, creating a more open conversational space beyond their pageant and hosting work.

title: A new role in pageant leadership
description: Is appointed Pageant Director of Mr. and Ms. Chinatown Global, taking on a leadership role connected to cultural representation and the next generation of contestants. Her film credit Dreamboi is also part of the public career record.

title: Onstage and on screen
description: Public coverage includes hosting Miss Iloilo 2026, returning to the Binibining Pilipinas stage, and appearances connected with the return of Miss Q&A on It's Showtime and GMA's The People Have Spoken.
